Hi Marissa —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and asks from Sierra Pharma: 

- We need a copy of Redwood's SOC 2 Type II report (redacted is fine) and any bridge letter for the current period.
- Can you grant our security team read-access to your Trust Portal so they can download the report and supporting evidence?
- Our procurement team will need the name of the contract owner and a contact for any contract questions (PO/invoice workflow).

Next steps from our side: I can loop in our security lead (Tom) and procurement if needed — they may have a short questionnaire after they review the report. Ideally we get portal access this week to keep our internal review on schedule.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Hi Samira —

Great talking earlier — thanks for the clear recap. Per your asks: 

1) SOC 2 Type II report and bridge letter: We can share a redacted copy of our SOC 2 Type II 2026 report and a bridge letter for the current period. I attached both as PDFs to this message for your immediate review. If your team needs the unredacted version we can provision access via the Trust Portal under a mutual NDA/contract clause — let me know which you prefer.

2) Trust Portal access: We can set up read-only access for Tom (or your security group). To complete the invite we need the email addresses of the reviewers and confirmation of the company domain (we have sierra-pharma.com on file). Portal link: https://redwood.trustportal.com/sierra-pharma.

3) Procurement/contact: Our procurement owner for this account is Dara Whitman (dara.whitman@redwood.com). For billing/POs please loop Dara; for contract redlines I can coordinate with our legal ops.

Action items I can take this week:
- Upload the redacted SOC 2 and bridge letter to the Trust Portal and send invite (once you confirm emails).
- Share a short vendor questionnaire template if Tom prefers to start there.

Attachments: SOC2_TypeII_2026_Redacted.pdf (pdf), Bridge_Letter_Apr2027.pdf (pdf)

If you want, I can also add Aditya on the portal invite to help with any technical evidence requests.

Best,
